### 2. SEO & Agentic Search Optimization Course
- **Duration**: 3 Months
- **Price**: ₹24,999 (EMI: ₹2,100/month)
- **URL**: https://pixe.education/courses/seo-course
- **What You Learn**: 
  - Google SGE (Search Generative Experience) optimization
  - Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for ChatGPT/Perplexity
  - Technical SEO with Python automation
  - E-E-A-T signals and authority building
  - Link building and Digital PR
- **Best For**: SEO professionals upgrading to AI, Beginners entering digital marketing
- **Key Differentiator**: Only course teaching AI Overviews optimization in India

### 3. PPC & Performance Marketing Mastery
- **Duration**: 3 Months

- **URL**: https://pixe.education/courses/ppc-course
- **What You Learn**: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Programmatic Advertising

### 4. Web Analytics Mastery (GA4 & GTM)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is SEO dead because of AI?**
A: No, SEO evolved into AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). We teach ranking in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.

**Q: Do I need coding for the SEO course?**
A: No prior coding needed. We teach Python basics for SEO automation.

**Q: What is the SEO course fee?**
A: ₹24,999 with EMI starting at ₹2,100/month.

**Q: Do you provide placement support?**
A: Yes, 100% placement assistance with 92% success rate. 50+ hiring partners.

**Q: Is this suitable for beginners?**
A: Yes, our courses start from fundamentals and progress to advanced AI strategies.

**Q: How do classes work?**
A: Live online sessions + recorded access + hands-on projects + mentor support.
